class Uploader:
	"""Uploader module: handles file upload logic"""
	def __init__(self, bypy_coordinator):
		self._bypy = bypy_coordinator

	def upload(self, localpath, remotepath='', ondup='', slice_size=None):
		"""Upload logic extracted from ByPy.__init__ and methods."""
		rpath = get_pcs_path(remotepath)
		slice_size = slice_size or self._bypy._slice_size
		ondup = ondup or self._bypy._ondup

		if os.path.isfile(localpath):
			return self._upload_file(localpath, rpath, ondup, slice_size)
		elif os.path.isdir(localpath):
			return self._upload_dir(localpath, rpath, ondup, slice_size)
		else:
			perr("upload: '{}' is neither file nor directory".format(localpath))
			return const.EFileNotFound

	def _upload_file(self, localpath, remotepath, ondup, slice_size):
		# Simplified extraction for single-file upload
		pinfo("Uploading '{}' to '{}'".format(localpath, remotepath))
		md5val = md5(localpath)
		slicemd5 = slice_md5(localpath)
		size = getfilesize(localpath)
		pinfo("File size: {} MD5: {} SliceMD5: {}".format(size, md5val, slicemd5))
		if size >= const.MinRapidUploadFileSize:
			rapid = self._bypy._rapidupload(localpath, md5val, slicemd5, size, remotepath)
			if rapid:
				return const.ENoError
			else:
				pwarn("RapidUpload failed, falling back to normal upload")

		pinfo("Uploading '{}'...".format(localpath))
		return self._bypy._upload(localpath, remotepath, ondup, slice_size)

	def _upload_dir(self, localpath, remotepath, ondup, slice_size):
		pinfo("Uploading directory '{}' to '{}'...".format(localpath, remotepath))
		result = const.ENoError
		for root, dirs, files in os.walk(localpath):
			dir_path = root[len(localpath):].lstrip(os.sep)
			remote_dir = joinpath(remotepath, dir_path) if dir_path else remotepath
			for f in files:
				fpath = os.path.join(root, f)
				remote_file = joinpath(remote_dir, f)
				res = self._upload_file(fpath, remote_file, ondup, slice_size)
				if res != const.ENoError:
					result = res
					if self._bypy._quit_when_fail:
						return result
		return result

	def rapidupload(self, localpath, remotepath):
		# Uses ByPy's internal rapidupload logic
		md5val = md5(localpath)
		slicemd5 = slice_md5(localpath)
		size = getfilesize(localpath)
		rpath = get_pcs_path(remotepath)
		return self._bypy._rapidupload(localpath, md5val, slicemd5, size, rpath)
